intent: Keep a note on each confirmation saying why the owner agreed.

edit.summary:
I proposed one change, in the `authoring` domain at `actions.confirm_element`. I left `delivery` alone, since confirmations only exist in `authoring`.

I set `records_decision: true` on `confirm_element`. That makes the confirmation a recorded decision, the same way `decide` and `approve_commit` work. Each confirmation can now carry the owner's optional `rationale`, which says why they agreed. Nothing else about the action changed: it is still person-only, still owner-only, and still replies with `record_confirmation`.

`check_draft` on `authoring` reports no issues. The proposal is `E-6-0d8f06d1`, still in the `proposed` stage until the owner confirms it.

Two things I did not do. I did not add a note field on the Element itself. I also did not change `confirm_all_proposed` or `confirm_wording_fix`, which also confirm elements. They can follow the same pattern if you want notes on those confirmations too.
